jobs.prompt: Original high-density detailed wuxia 2D game VFX. FOUR chronological animation cels in a precise 2x2 atlas. Each cell contains exactly ONE golden-orange FIRE DOG spirit RUNNING TOWARD RIGHT, distinct alternating foreleg/hindleg gait poses, clear pointed muzzle, ears and tail made of flame. No ring, no other dogs, no actor, no floor. Same size and ground baseline across all four. Crisp continuous bright flame cores, dark-orange edge structure, transparent empty interior gaps. True transparent PNG with generous alpha-zero gutters and all corners fully empty. No white/grey fog, no backdrop, no opaque panel, no text. Entire dog and flame tail fully within each quadrant.

Original high-density detailed wuxia 2D gameplay WEAPON animation, true transparent PNG. A precise 2x2 four-cel atlas of ONE long straight brown WOODEN STAFF with dark bronze/gold end bindings. Each complete staff is horizontal, handle/emission anchor at LEFT, striking tip at RIGHT. Cels: short preparing extension, long fully extended shaft, full length impact-ready shaft with a tiny warm spark at right tip, retracting shorter shaft. Uniform shaft thickness, straight continuous edges, finely readable wood grain and two gold bindings. No hands or body. Spacious transparent alpha-zero padding in every quadrant. No fog, no background, no shadow, no filled glow rectangle. This is the separate staff extension for a forward martial-art slam, not a blade, flame beam or projectile.

Original high-density wuxia 2D GAME VFX atlas, true transparent PNG. Exactly FOUR COLUMNS and FIVE ROWS, 20 isolated cels, generous alpha-zero gutters and corners. Every row is one different element, four columns chronological gather/active/impact/fade for that element. Row1 WOOD: emerald-green leaves and thorn-shaped qi. Row2 FIRE: red-orange flame curls and ember burst. Row3 EARTH: ochre-gold jagged rock shards and ground dust impact. Row4 METAL: silver-white sharp sword fragments and metallic qi glints. Row5 WATER: cobalt-blue flowing water ribbons and small ice droplets. Each cel has one compact outward qi burst around an EMPTY readable centre, same size and centre per row. Element palettes must remain completely separate, never mix all colors in one cell. Crisp continuous silhouettes and sharp light/shadow masses. No actors, no letters, no icon frames, no white/grey/colored matte, no fog panels, no checkerboard. Each effect wholly inside its cell.
